# Clip 1.3.10
Clip 1.3.10 makes app-to-app Live Share sharper when a window from a standard 1× display is viewed on a Retina Mac.
## Native viewer
- Keep WebRTC's Metal drawable at the decoded video resolution so presentation scaling no longer blurs the source inside the video shader. - Use nearest-neighbour sampling whenever shared content is enlarged, including standard-display shares shown at their native logical size on Retina. - Continue using filtered scaling when Retina content is reduced for a smaller window or standard-density display. - Snap tiny odd-dimension encoder differences to the intended integer scale instead of stretching every source pixel fractionally.
## Requirements
Clip requires macOS 15 or later on Apple silicon. This build uses the same stable Apple Development identity as previous updater releases.
